'''David Kangas''' (DeckTech and Game Players Network handle '''Icebreath''')<ref name="dt-23975">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/23975 QMC Clouds], DeckTech (David "Icebreath" Kangas, 16 June 2002). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/23975/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/23975/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261009092820/http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/23975/ Wayback Machine].</ref> posted a [[Light]] [[Quiet Mining Colony / Independent Operation|Quiet Mining Colony]] list on DeckTech (''QMC Clouds'') and published constructed lists on [[Game Players Network]].

He finished 3rd in the PC's Winter Classic Contest, announced on 31 March 2003, as "David Kangas, Brush Prairie WA".<ref name="pc-classic03">[https://web.archive.org/web/20030824053912/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/News/classicnews03312003.htm Classic Format Contest Results are In!], swccgpc.com. Internet Archive capture 24 August 2003.</ref> On 25 October 2004 he posted on the PC forums that he had resigned from the Players Committee and stepped down as Endor Flight Leader; he signed as "Formerely Shadow 31, Endor Flight Leader". The same post says [[Greg Anderson]] ran all three days of the 2004 World Championship and that [[John Hawkins]] had won the Endor Regional.<ref name="pcf-4063" />
